blocking_gate.detail: The canonical row's github, review_binding, and source_ref all name the reviewed subject PR #4314 on task/L12-GAP-TRIPLE-AUDIT-DOC-20260728, not this task's own closeout branch. The gate fails closed and revokes auto-merge.

Human/Ops supplies Pantheon root merge freeze 2026-07-27 on that same exact head.
python3 scripts/git/auto_integrator.py --execute --task-id L12-GAP-TRIPLE-AUDIT-DOC-REVIEW-20260728 merges the approved exact head.
Owner then runs the governed done command.

closeout_delivery.why_a_commit_was_required: delivery_gates.require_commit_hash with commit_conventions.subject_must_include_task_id forces the worktree HEAD subject to contain this task id, and delivery_gates.require_merged_pr forces that HEAD to be an ancestor of origin/dev. A review-only task with no commit cannot satisfy either, so done cannot run until this closeout PR merges.
